title: “The brave don’t post it. They pay for it.”
paragraphs: “The brave don’t post it. They pay for it.”

Luke 9:23 (ESV)
“If anyone would come after me, let him deny himself and take up his cross daily and follow me.”

This verse encapsulates costly boldness — not performative courage, but a faith that bears weight and sacrifice.
It mirrors the line’s essence: true courage in faith is never cosmetic; it’s cruciform — it costs something.
